name: spinner
title: Spinner
summary: A small spinning ring for work of unknown length.
description: A small spinning ring for work of unknown length. Ring with a single ink arc, spinning at 700ms. Fast on purpose: a quick spinner makes the wait feel shorter.

decorative.description: Purely visual, inside something that is already a status region (selection-actions' status): aria-hidden, no role=status and no label.

notes: The label is the accessible name; make it say what is loading.
Do not show a spinner for work that finishes in under 300ms; the flash reads as a glitch.

motion: keeps spinning under prefers-reduced-motion: it is the loading signal, not decoration
